summary: Atkore Inc. filed an 8-K disclosing entry into a merger agreement with Prysmian S.p.A. (Buyer) and its subsidiary Merger Sub. Under the agreement, all outstanding Atkore shares will be acquired for $95.00 per share in cash, representing a premium over the market price. The transaction is structured as a merger of Merger Sub into Atkore, with Atkore surviving as a wholly owned subsidiary of Buyer. Equity awards (options, RSUs, PSUs) will be canceled and converted into cash based on the merger consideration. No board recommendation or advisors are mentioned in the excerpt; the deal is subject to customary conditions and regulatory approvals. Watch for shareholder vote and antitrust review timing.
